info.schedule: First Tuesday monthly, Clayton County Courthouse, Jonesboro
info.note: Monthly sale lists include fair market value and the opening (cry-out) bid. Results are not published; the excess funds list shows which parcels sold above the bid.

auction.venue: Clayton County Courthouse steps (Harold R. Banke Justice Center)
auction.time: First Tuesday of the month, sale begins promptly at 10:00 am; no sales in December or January
auction.registration: Register in person on sale morning or online through the Bidder Pre-Registration form on the tax sales page. Bring a valid state-issued photo ID, which is exchanged for a bidding paddle; arrive early for check-in.
auction.payment: Certified funds only: cash, money order or cashier's check. Winning bidders pay at the Property Tax Office, 121 S. McDonough St., Jonesboro, between 12:00 pm and 3:00 pm on sale day; unpaid parcels are re-cried at 3:30 pm.
auction.office: Clayton County Tax Commissioner, Property Tax Office
auction.office_address: 121 S. McDonough St., Annex 3, 2nd Floor, Jonesboro, GA 30236
vital: Redemption period is 12 months and one day; the redemption penalty starts at 20% and rises 10% each additional year.
Judicial in rem sales go through Superior Court and cut the redemption period to 60 days.
Winners must complete the blue Winning Bidder's Form at the sale; the name and address on it go on the tax deed.
Failure to pay on time can put you on the ineligible bidder list for six months and lead to a lien for the county's loss.
The final list can shrink up to sale day as owners pay; the office gives no extra property information.
The buyer cannot enter or take possession until the redemption period ends and the right of redemption is barred.
auction.next_dates: First Tuesday of each month except December and January (subject to change)
